purpose: Assess one requirement against deterministic quality rules and governed evidence
positive_triggers: User asks to review, assess, or test the quality of a requirement
negative_triggers: User asks to implement an already accepted requirement
preconditions: Requirement identity and version are resolved

procedure.instruction: Discover available requirement, rule, and source evidence before asking questions
Run deterministic quality rules before bounded inference
Assess unresolved semantic gaps with citations and uncertainty
procedure.decision_rule: Never infer missing business intent as fact

postconditions: Every finding has severity, evidence, and proposed next action
